craft_notes: Sthāyin: void-triple-coda (the block's close: mouth-within-without: the void TOTALLY enclosed — then mother grants FORMLESS: the coda's address is to HER: formlessness as GRANT). Sanskrit: śūnyamukhāntaṃ śūnyaṃ...mātuḥ...rūpāni vinirmun me...vṛṣyākṣi → L4 keeps triple-void line 1, mother-grant line 2. Rows: row 3 (may-she→grant). Close: to me (me — the dative: TO ME: the whole practice-block ends in one requested grant: personhood at the void's mouth: kept, it's the turn). Rejected: 'emptiness is within emptiness' easy — killed: mouth kept (mukha as the void's FACE: void-mouth returns v133's face-cluster); 'O deer-eyed mother' reordered — killed: deer-eyed at close (vocative-class-with-eyes: the address-word of tenderness at the end of force).

lines: Void's mouth, void within, void's outside:
mother, may She, deer-eyed, grant formlessness to me.
l4.sanskrit_cite: atra caikatame yukto jāyate bhairavaḥ svayam | vācā karoti karmāṇi śāpānugrahakārakaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What happens in one's own yoking? → Self-yoked, one IS Bhairava — his speech becomes curser-and-favorer.
c1_essence: Yoked here: IS Bhairava; speech curser-and-favorer.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with śānta (wonder settled into stillness)
